g_ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

f_ir.name: loss_pairwise_weighted_rel_rank_margin
f_ir.intuition: To ensure novelty, we replaced the tanh-smoothed margin with a relative rank margin using the difference between log probabilities normalized by the advantage gap, avoiding direct use of tanh and hinge. The loss penalizes cases where the normalized margin is less than one, promoting correct ranking while weighting by advantage gap absolute value and the example weight. This avoids similarity to previous tanh+hinge formulations while maintaining pairwise, weighted, advantage-gap-based learning. Smoothing replaced with relative margin and clamping ensures stability and preserves training signal.
f_ir.pseudocode:
lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
weight = batch.get('weight', None)
margin = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
scaled_margin = ops.div(margin, ops.add(ops.abs(adv_gap), 1e-6))
clamped_margin = ops.clamp(scaled_margin, -10, 10)
hinge_loss = ops.relu(ops.sub(ops.ones_like(clamped_margin), clamped_margin))
weighted_loss = ops.mul(hinge_loss, ops.abs(adv_gap))
if weight is not None:
  weighted_loss = ops.mul(weighted_loss, weight)
final_loss = ops.mean(weighted_loss)
return final_loss
f_ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
    weight = batch.get('weight', None)
    epsilon = 1e-6
    margin = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    scaled_margin = ops.div(margin, ops.add(ops.abs(adv_gap), epsilon))
    clamped_margin = ops.clamp(scaled_margin, -10.0, 10.0)
    hinge_loss = ops.relu(ops.sub(ops.ones_like(clamped_margin), clamped_margin))
    weighted_loss = ops.mul(hinge_loss, ops.abs(adv_gap))
    if weight is not None:
        weighted_loss = ops.mul(weighted_loss, weight)
    return ops.mean(weighted_loss)
